next.reason: Amendment 2 (X3.23b-1993, page VI-96) renumbered this rule (old GR1, behind its new general rule 1) and its reference, 'general rules 5 through 7' to 'general rules 6 through 8'; the requirement is the printed one: inspection 'begins at the leftmost character position of the data item referenced by identifier-1, regardless of its class, and proceeds from left to right to the rightmost character position as described in general rules 6 through 8' (§1985:VI.6.18.4 GR2). §2023:14.9.22.4 GR3 repeats those words and adds a case: 'unless BACKWARD is specified, in which case, inspection ... begins at the rightmost character position of the data item referenced by identifier-1, regardless of its class, and proceeds from right to left to the leftmost character position'. The 1985 rule gives every INSPECT one direction and its format has no BACKWARD; §2023:14.9.22.2 puts an optional BACKWARD before identifier-1 in every format, so a right-to-left inspection, refused in 1985, is accepted: a case added. An INSPECT without BACKWARD runs the same in both.
